now: assisted; tool success is not scene success; max effort only on opening seconds

still.trigger: A request for a single frame with one named subject, to be scored. Quiet when the ask is to animate, render a sequence, or touch a level or engine project.
still.doneWhen: jq -e '(.frames|length)==1 and (.subject|type=="string") and (.score|type=="number")' still.json exits 0; score null with no scorer is reported unscored, a valid result; a human score is assisted, never a pass.
still.forbidden: Animating, or adding a second subject or second frame, before the still is scored; writing a score the scorer did not return.

time.trigger: A time t and a renderer that takes t as its only time input. Quiet when no t-addressable renderer exists (generic video generator) or when the ask is a full render.
time.doneWhen: Render the frame at t twice; cmp frame_t_a.png frame_t_b.png exits 0 and the output directory holds exactly one frame file; a renderer not a function of t is reported unsupported, a valid result.
time.forbidden: Rendering the full sequence to reach frame t, or drawing any frame other than t.

score.trigger: A contact sheet with a per-frame score file from an external scorer. Quiet when no external score exists, or when the ask is the full render.
score.doneWhen: A program over before.json and after.json prints 'changed frames: 1' (only the worst-scoring frame differs) and the rescored worst frame is higher; below threshold is a valid result and no full render starts.
score.forbidden: Fixing more than the worst frame, or starting the full render before the threshold is met.

asset.trigger: A request to make or fix a mesh, UV, or rig asset. Quiet when the ask is to place the asset in a level or to bundle all stages in one prompt.
asset.doneWhen: jq -e '(.stages==["mesh","uv","rig","animation"]) and (.rig.kind=="default") and (.clips|length)==1 and (.placed_in_level==false)' asset.json exits 0; a manifest listing only completed earlier stages is valid; editor playback stays assisted.
asset.forbidden: Bundling mesh, UV, rig and animation in one prompt, or importing or placing the asset in the level before one animation played on the default rig.

level.trigger: A level edit in exactly one change class: terrain, light, character, or interaction. Quiet when the ask spans classes or wants unattended level building.
level.doneWhen: git diff --name-only lists only files of the one named change class and the editor path check result is quoted; no editor check means unvalidated; a broken path is reverted, shown by an empty git diff.
level.forbidden: Treating tool success as scene success: calling the level done because the edit command exited 0, or changing a second class in the same pass.

engine.trigger: An engine project (Unity, Unreal, Godot) on disk and a request to change one system. Quiet when no project is present or the system is unnamed.
engine.doneWhen: Before any edit the named system is quoted with file path and line; afterward git diff --name-only lists only files of that system; path walk needs an absent connector, so report walk not run.
engine.forbidden: Writing before reading the project, or editing a system that was not named first.
